0022600093.text: Both the Sacramento Kings and LA Clippers open their 2026-27 seasons, with the Kings visiting, and Sacramento is missing Dylan Cardwell (calf strain) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The Clippers are without Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (foot) and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery). In 2025-26 the Kings lost the season series 1-3, including a 138-109 loss in Sacramento on April 5, 2026, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Sacramento a 35% chance of winning this game.
